WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount,
       g.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
